newsitem.title: USA: American Electromedics sets reverse split.
newsitem.headline: American Electromedics sets reverse split.

text.p: American Electromedics Corp said on Thursday its board of directors approved a one-for-five reverse stock split effective November 8.
After the stock split, the Nasdaq symbol for the new shares would be AMER.O, the company said.
Shares would be rounded in lieu of fractional shares, the company said, and the split would reduce the number of shares outstanding to 2.5 million shares.
There would be no change in the number of authorized shares or par value because of the stock split, it said.
